notes.title: Patch v1.0.4: More Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Small non game impacting patch!

Game Engine
- Upgraded from Unity 2020.2.3 to 2020.2.5 for stability/performance improvements

Audio Fixes
- Fixed audio bug that was causing "select" sound not to play for various menu buttons

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where in local multiplayer mode players could select DLC bug families without owning the DLC bug famsss 

Special thanks to Discord members for sharing their bugs (good and bad)! See ya'll next patch.

Stay Thirsty
- Ben

notes.title: Patch v1.0.2: NETCODE GAINS
notes.content:
[u][b]THE BIG STUFF aka Networking Code Improvements[/b][/u]

Hey guys, this patch I completely reworked the way online multiplayer data is sent. I upgraded from the legacy Steamworks "Peer-to-Peer" networking library to the new Steamworks "Socket Server" networking library! This should dramatically improve network latecy and cut down on some of the desync players playing across far distances have been experiencing. 

[u][b]UI Fixes
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed version number on main menu from sliding off screen when resizing window
[/list]

[u][b]Balance Changes
[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Boosted the speed boost bugs receive from zap tiles, this should make their function more noticeable and buff their ability to change the landscape of the countertop
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where when a Rhino Beetle sped up a beetle that was stuck in a spiderweb the behavior was unpredictable
[/list]

Thanks so much community! The reception so far has been so positive and made me smile so so much.  See ya'll next patch. Happy slurping

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1 Notes!
notes.content:

[u][b]UI Changes
[/b][/u]
[olist]
[*]Updated Bug Compendium menu language to better inform what each bug's special abilities are
[*]Added clarification to Controls menu to address confusion around using the mouse to select bugs on bug selectionradial menu
[/olist]

[u][b]Balance Changes[/b][/u]
[olist]
[*]Buffed multiplier of Wolf Spider speed up bark and Wolf Spider base speed
[*]Buffed Yellowjacket speed
[*]Buffed Ladybug speed
[/olist]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

[*]Fixed collision box on Soda Stream that was causing it to collide with bugs not on row/column it was passing through

Thanks so much community! See ya'll next patch. Happy slurping
